column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 3 Zero joins the party
# offset<TAB>english      The pixel-aware wrapper supplies layout.

column2: With the autumn $$Ｇ１戦線$$ just ahead...
when I heard that you, rumored to be my greatest rival...
had run away from this $$闘技場$$, I could not believe my ears...
I, who cast aside the status of a black $$羽$$...
and you, a $$ファインブラッド$$ raised to become the strongest $$剣闘士$$...
Strength alone...
The contest between you and me—we who were supposed to pursue nothing but strength...
to be decided without our ever crossing swords even once...
Honestly, I could not stand it...
So when I heard a search party had been organized to find you two...
I jumped at the chance!
I mean, is that not right?!
This would decide...
which of us was truly the strongest!!
That was what I thought...
But when I found you again, your eyes were full of impatience...
and you seemed unable to focus...
That was why, to make our rematch possible...
I deliberately let you escape then...
But why?!
Why did you escape from here...
with your woman in tow?!
She was a woman the $$領主$$ gave us so that we would have children...
Truthfully, I scarcely even knew what she was like...
But at that time...
she was carrying my child...
I could not let my own child go through the same thing...
Day after day, solely for rich people's amusement...
a life spent beating to death people I did not even hate...
That was the one kind of life I could not make my child live...
You two may each have complicated circumstances...
But if you both seek to be truly strongest...
even if you keep competing in stubborn pride here...
I do not think it means much...
For at the $$総本山$$ we are headed to...
there should be the strongest enemy in this $$世界$$...
Besides, neither you nor we can afford to take our time now...
After the person who was supposed to be killed was spared and the match abandoned...
I doubt they will simply let us go unpunished...
What say you? Let us agree to a temporary truce...
and join us in seeking true strength!?
Are you... all right with that?!
Do whatever you like!!
Then it is settled!!
My real name is $$クレージュ$$!
It was wrong of me not to say, but I think it is pretty rude that you all did not notice too...?!
What did you call me, woman?!
Ding-dong, ding-dong... An announcement regarding the results of the deliberation...
Regarding both teams suddenly stopping their combat during the match, the referees...
This is bad...!!
For now, let's get out of here fast!
Why, with the two of you...
the guards here will be no more than scarecrows!!
All right, let's go... partner!!
$$ゼロ$$ has joined the party!
My real name is $$クレージュ$$!
It was wrong of me not to say, but I think it is pretty rude that you all did not notice too...?!
What did you call me, woman?!
Everyone... I made you waste time for my sake...
I am sorry...
Do not fret over such nonsense...
Besides, seeing what a fool you are...
was rather entertaining, in its own way!!
What did you call me?!
Nyah-nyah, fool!!
Well, anyway, once we cross this hill, we will finally reach the city where $$ユダ$$ said the $$大邪神$$ armor lies...
$$パンデモニウム$$...
From here on, we must be all the more vigilant...
Hey...
I think I might understand, just a little, what the word $$愛$$ means...
No! It is nothing...
Me, talking about $$愛$$...!
